newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Costello says Australia GDP points to growth.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Costello says Australia GDP points to growth.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said on Wednesday the March quarter gross domestic product data released earlier on the day pointed to favourable economic prospects for the coming year.

He also said the figures suggested the economy was poised for an acceleration in growth and provided further evidence that Australia's low inflation environment was locked in. "This is a good outcome and a pointer to very favourable prospects in the forthcoming year," Costello said in a statement.
Australia's seasonally adjusted average gross domestic product, which averages income, expenditure and production measures of GDP, rose 0.9 percent in the March quarter.
Real GDP-A in the year to March rose 2.4 percent.

"The composition of activity in the quarter, with very strong growth in final demand and a sharp rundown in non-farm stocks combined with other indicators of activity, suggest the economy is poised for an acceleration in growth," Costello said.
"The accounts provide further evidence of Australia's success in locking in low inflation," he said.
Most economists had forecast March quarter GDP-A to rise around 0.8 percent, for a year-on-year increase of about 2.2 percent.
